## Load and clean data

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(GEOquery)
library(data.table)
library(edgeR)

# ── Expression matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
expr_raw <- fread("int/GSE168508_gene_expression-MF_skin-biopsy_sample_.txt")

# Drop non-expression column, aggregate duplicate gene symbols by mean
expr_raw[, genes := NULL]
expr_agg      <- expr_raw[, lapply(.SD, mean), by = Symbol, .SDcols = -"Symbol"]
mat           <- as.matrix(expr_agg[, -"Symbol"])
rownames(mat) <- expr_agg$Symbol

# ── GEO metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gse  <- getGEO("GSE168508", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
meta <- pData(gse[[1]])

# Strip ":ch1" suffix, collapse whitespace/special chars to underscore, lowercase
clean_names <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub(":ch1$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]]", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  tolower(x)
}
colnames(meta) <- clean_names(colnames(meta))
rownames(meta) <- meta$title

# Extract key clinical variables with clean names
meta$os_time   <- as.numeric(meta$os_time_mo)
meta$os_event  <- as.integer(meta$survival)        # already 0/1
meta$pfs_time  <- as.numeric(meta$pfs_time_mo)
meta$pfs_event <- as.integer(meta$progression)     # already 0/1
meta$lct       <- ifelse(is.na(meta$lct) | meta$lct == "", "NLCT", meta$lct)

# ── Align samples ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
common <- intersect(colnames(mat), rownames(meta))
mat    <- mat[, common]
meta   <- meta[common, ]

# ── Log-normalize ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(mat, log = TRUE)

cat("Expression matrix:", nrow(mat), "genes x", ncol(mat), "samples\n")
cat("Metadata:", nrow(meta), "samples,", ncol(meta), "variables\n")
cat("LCT status:", table(meta$lct), "\n")

saveRDS(mat, "surv.mat.rds")
saveRDS(meta, "surv.meta.rds")
```

## Clean metadata

```{r clean-metadata}
# Keep only clinically relevant, variable columns — drop GEO boilerplate,
# protocol fields, contact info, and redundant characteristics_ch1.* columns
keep_cols <- c(
  "title", "geo_accession",
  "sex", "onset_age_yr", "duration_of_disease_yr",
  "lct",
  "tnmb_stage", "tnmb_staging_t", "tnmb_staging_n", "tnmb_staging_m", "tnmb_staging_b",
  "os_time", "os_event",
  "pfs_time", "pfs_event"
)
meta.ss <- meta[, keep_cols]

meta.ss$onset_age_yr           <- as.numeric(meta.ss$onset_age_yr)
meta.ss$duration_of_disease_yr <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta.ss$duration_of_disease_yr))  # one true NA in source
meta.ss$lct                    <- factor(meta.ss$lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT"))
meta.ss$sex                    <- factor(meta.ss$sex)
meta.ss$tnmb_stage             <- factor(meta.ss$tnmb_stage,
                                      levels = c("IA","IB","IIA","IIB","IIIA","IIIB","IVA1","IVA2","IVB"))
meta.ss$tnmb_staging_t         <- as.integer(meta.ss$tnmb_staging_t)
meta.ss$tnmb_staging_n         <- as.integer(meta.ss$tnmb_staging_n)
meta.ss$tnmb_staging_m         <- as.integer(meta.ss$tnmb_staging_m)
meta.ss$tnmb_staging_b         <- as.integer(meta.ss$tnmb_staging_b)

str(meta.ss)

saveRDS(meta.ss, "surv.meta.ss.rds")
```


```{r load-saved}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
mat  <- readRDS("~/Rstudio/CTCL/int/surv.mat.rds")
meta <- readRDS("~/Rstudio/CTCL/int/surv.meta.ss.rds")
logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(mat, log = TRUE)
```

```{r optimize_n_genes}
res_skin  <- readRDS("results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")
n_vals    <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 75, 100)

score_search <- lapply(n_vals, function(n) {
  genes_up   <- intersect(res_skin %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% slice_head(n = n) %>% pull(gene), rownames(logcpm))
  genes_down <- intersect(res_skin %>% arrange(t)        %>% slice_head(n = n) %>% pull(gene), rownames(logcpm))

  s_up   <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_up,   , drop = FALSE])
  s_down <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_down, , drop = FALSE])

  df <- meta %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    mutate(composite = s_up[sample] - s_down[sample]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(pfs_time), !is.na(pfs_event), !is.na(composite))

  cox_os  <- coxph(Surv(os_time,  os_event)  ~ composite, data = df)
  cox_pfs <- coxph(Surv(pfs_time, pfs_event) ~ composite, data = df)

  data.frame(
    n         = n,
    c_os      = concordance(cox_os)$concordance,
    c_pfs     = concordance(cox_pfs)$concordance,
    p_os      = summary(cox_os)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    p_pfs     = summary(cox_pfs)$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
})

score_search_df <- bind_rows(score_search) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(c_os, c_pfs), names_to = "endpoint", values_to = "cindex") %>%
  mutate(endpoint = recode(endpoint, c_os = "OS", c_pfs = "PFS"))

best_os  <- score_search_df %>% filter(endpoint == "OS")  %>% slice_max(cindex, n = 1)
best_pfs <- score_search_df %>% filter(endpoint == "PFS") %>% slice_max(cindex, n = 1)
message(sprintf("Best n for OS:  %d (C-index = %.3f)", best_os$n,  best_os$cindex))
message(sprintf("Best n for PFS: %d (C-index = %.3f)", best_pfs$n, best_pfs$cindex))

ggplot(score_search_df, aes(x = n, y = cindex, color = endpoint)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_os$n,  linetype = "dashed", color = "#E41A1C", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_pfs$n, linetype = "dashed", color = "#377EB8", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("OS" = "#E41A1C", "PFS" = "#377EB8")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = n_vals) +
  labs(x = "Number of genes (top/bottom n)", y = "C-index", color = "Endpoint",
       title = "C-index by signature size",
       caption = "Dashed lines = optimal n per endpoint. Note: optimized on same data — exploratory only.") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r km_by_n}
for (n in n_vals) {
  genes_up   <- intersect(res_skin %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% slice_head(n = n) %>% pull(gene), rownames(logcpm))
  genes_down <- intersect(res_skin %>% arrange(t)        %>% slice_head(n = n) %>% pull(gene), rownames(logcpm))

  s_up   <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_up,   , drop = FALSE])
  s_down <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_down, , drop = FALSE])

  df <- meta %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    mutate(
      composite     = s_up[sample] - s_down[sample],
      subtype_class = factor(ifelse(composite >= mean(composite, na.rm = TRUE),
                                    "Subtype2-like", "Subtype1-like"),
                             levels = c("Subtype1-like", "Subtype2-like"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(subtype_class))

  print(plot_km(df, "subtype_class", paste0("OS — n = ", n, " genes per direction")))
}
```

```{r subtype_survival}
res_skin <- readRDS("results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")

# top 25 up (Subtype2-high) and bottom 25 (Subtype1-high) by t
top25_up   <- res_skin %>% arrange(desc(t)) %>% slice_head(n = 25) %>% pull(gene)
top25_down <- res_skin %>% arrange(t)        %>% slice_head(n = 25) %>% pull(gene)

genes_up   <- intersect(top25_up,   rownames(logcpm))
genes_down <- intersect(top25_down, rownames(logcpm))

# mean expression scores per sample
score_up   <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_up,   , drop = FALSE])
score_down <- colMeans(logcpm[genes_down, , drop = FALSE])

surv_df <- meta %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(
    score_up   = score_up[sample],
    score_down = score_down[sample],
    high_up    = score_up   >= mean(score_up,   na.rm = TRUE),
    high_down  = score_down >= mean(score_down, na.rm = TRUE),
    subtype_class = case_when(
       high_up & !high_down ~ "Subtype2-like",
      !high_up &  high_down ~ "Subtype1-like",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

plot_km <- function(df, group_var, title, time_var = "os_time", event_var = "os_event") {
  df <- df[!is.na(df[[group_var]]) & !is.na(df[[time_var]]) & !is.na(df[[event_var]]), ]
  form <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  fit  <- eval(bquote(survfit(.(form), data = df)))
  ggsurvplot(fit, data = df, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
             title = title, xlab = "Time (months)", legend.title = group_var,
             ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 11))
}

km_up    <- plot_km(surv_df %>% mutate(group = ifelse(high_up,   "High", "Low")), "group", "Subtype2 score (up genes)")
km_down  <- plot_km(surv_df %>% mutate(group = ifelse(high_down, "High", "Low")), "group", "Subtype1 score (down genes)")
km_class <- plot_km(surv_df, "subtype_class", "Combined subtype class")

km_up
km_down
km_class
```

```{r lct_deg}
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

meta_lct <- meta[colnames(logcpm), ]
meta_lct$lct <- factor(meta_lct$lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT"))
design <- model.matrix(~ lct, data = meta_lct)

fit_lct <- lmFit(logcpm, design)
fit_lct <- eBayes(fit_lct)

res_lct <- topTable(fit_lct, coef = "lctLCT", number = Inf) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(sig = adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(adj.P.Val)

message(sprintf("LCT vs NLCT significant DEGs: %d", sum(res_lct$sig)))

lfc_lim_lct <- quantile(abs(res_lct$logFC), 0.99)
ggplot(res_lct, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value),
                     color = pmin(pmax(logFC, -lfc_lim_lct), lfc_lim_lct),
                     size = abs(t))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "grey80", high = "firebrick",
                        midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lfc_lim_lct, lfc_lim_lct), name = "log2FC") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.3, 3), name = "|t|") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / nrow(res_lct)), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "log2FC (LCT vs NLCT)", y = "-log10(p-value)", title = "LCT vs NLCT DEGs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r lct_vs_subtype}
res_skin <- readRDS("results/res_skin_subtypes.rds")

shared <- inner_join(
  res_lct  %>% select(gene, t_lct = t, lfc_lct = logFC, sig_lct = sig),
  res_skin %>% select(gene, t_sub = t, lfc_sub = logFC, sig_sub = sig),
  by = "gene"
)

cor_val <- cor(shared$t_lct, shared$t_sub, method = "spearman")
message(sprintf("Spearman correlation of t-statistics: %.3f", cor_val))

shared <- shared %>%
  mutate(concordance = case_when(
    sig_lct & sig_sub ~ "Both significant",
    sig_lct           ~ "LCT only",
    sig_sub           ~ "Subtype only",
    TRUE              ~ "Neither"
  ))

ggplot(shared, aes(x = t_sub, y = t_lct, color = concordance)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both significant" = "firebrick",
                                "LCT only"         = "#FF7F00",
                                "Subtype only"     = "#377EB8",
                                "Neither"          = "grey70")) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
           label = sprintf("rho = %.3f", cor_val), size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "t statistic (Subtype2 vs Subtype1)",
       y = "t statistic (NLCT vs LCT)",
       title = "Subtype vs LCT DEG concordance") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r cox_composite_score}
cox_df <- surv_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(lct), !is.na(score_up), !is.na(score_down)) %>%
  mutate(
    lct            = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")),
    composite_z    = scale(score_up - score_down)[, 1]
  )

cox_lct_uni  <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ lct,         data = cox_df)
cox_comp_uni <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ composite_z, data = cox_df)
cox_multi1   <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ lct + composite_z, data = cox_df)

cat("── Univariate: LCT ──\n");             print(summary(cox_lct_uni)$coefficients)
cat("── Univariate: composite score ──\n"); print(summary(cox_comp_uni)$coefficients)
cat("── Multivariate ──\n");               print(summary(cox_multi1)$coefficients)

ggforest(cox_multi1, data = cox_df,
         main = "Multivariate Cox: LCT + composite subtype score")
```

```{r cox_binary_subtype}
cox_df2 <- surv_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(lct), !is.na(score_up), !is.na(score_down)) %>%
  mutate(
    lct           = factor(lct, levels = c("NLCT", "LCT")),
    composite     = score_up - score_down,
    subtype_class = factor(ifelse(composite >= median(composite), "Subtype2-like", "Subtype1-like"),
                           levels = c("Subtype1-like", "Subtype2-like"))
  )

cox_sub_uni <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ subtype_class, data = cox_df2)
cox_multi2  <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ lct + subtype_class, data = cox_df2)

cat("── Univariate: subtype class ──\n"); print(summary(cox_sub_uni)$coefficients)
cat("── Multivariate ──\n");             print(summary(cox_multi2)$coefficients)

ggforest(cox_multi2, data = cox_df2,
         main = "Multivariate Cox: LCT + binary subtype class")
```

```{r cindex_improvement}
# C-index: does adding the composite score improve discrimination over LCT alone?
c_lct   <- concordance(cox_lct_uni)
c_multi <- concordance(cox_multi1)

cat(sprintf("C-index — LCT alone:          %.3f (SE: %.3f)\n", c_lct$concordance,   sqrt(c_lct$var)))
cat(sprintf("C-index — LCT + composite:    %.3f (SE: %.3f)\n", c_multi$concordance, sqrt(c_multi$var)))
cat(sprintf("Delta C-index:                %.3f\n", c_multi$concordance - c_lct$concordance))
```

```{r timedep_auc_os}
#install.packages("timeROC")
library(timeROC)

# build a clean df with all predictors, complete cases only
auc_df <- cox_df2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(composite), !is.na(lct)) %>%
  mutate(lct_bin = as.integer(lct == "LCT"))

times <- c(12, 24, 36, 48, 60)

roc_comp <- timeROC(T = auc_df$os_time, delta = auc_df$os_event,
                    marker = auc_df$composite, cause = 1,
                    times = times, iid = TRUE)

roc_lct  <- timeROC(T = auc_df$os_time, delta = auc_df$os_event,
                    marker = auc_df$lct_bin, cause = 1,
                    times = times, iid = TRUE)

auc_os_df <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(time = times, AUC = roc_comp$AUC, se = roc_comp$inference$vect_sd_1, predictor = "Composite score"),
  data.frame(time = times, AUC = roc_lct$AUC,  se = roc_lct$inference$vect_sd_1,  predictor = "LCT binary")
) %>%
  mutate(lo = AUC - 1.96 * se, hi = AUC + 1.96 * se)

ggplot(auc_os_df, aes(x = time, y = AUC, color = predictor, fill = predictor)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = times) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Composite score" = "#E41A1C", "LCT binary" = "#377EB8")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Composite score" = "#E41A1C", "LCT binary" = "#377EB8")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ylim(0.4, 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (months)", y = "Time-dependent AUC",
       title = "OS: composite score vs LCT binary", color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)

# formal AUC difference test at each time point
cat("── OS: AUC difference (composite - LCT) ──\n")
for (i in seq_along(times)) {
  cmp <- compare(roc_comp, roc_lct, adjusted = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("t=%d mo: ΔAUC=%.3f, p=%.3f\n", times[i],
              roc_comp$AUC[i] - roc_lct$AUC[i], cmp$p_values_AUC[i]))
}
```

```{r cindex_difference}
# formal test of C-index difference between continuous score and LCT binary
cox_lct_bin  <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ lct_bin,   data = auc_df)
cox_comp_con <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ composite, data = auc_df)

c_lct_bin  <- concordance(cox_lct_bin)
c_comp_con <- concordance(cox_comp_con)

# contrast: difference and its SE
c_diff <- concordance(cox_lct_bin, cox_comp_con)
cat(sprintf("C-index LCT binary:       %.3f (SE %.3f)\n", c_lct_bin$concordance,  sqrt(c_lct_bin$var)))
cat(sprintf("C-index composite score:  %.3f (SE %.3f)\n", c_comp_con$concordance, sqrt(c_comp_con$var)))
diff_est <- c_comp_con$concordance - c_lct_bin$concordance
diff_se  <- sqrt(sum(c_diff$var) - 2 * c_diff$var[3])
cat(sprintf("Delta C-index:            %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f – %.3f, p=%.3f)\n",
            diff_est,
            diff_est - 1.96 * diff_se,
            diff_est + 1.96 * diff_se,
            2 * pnorm(-abs(diff_est / diff_se))))
```
